changes.comment: Initial release of the Vite plugin as a separate package. Existing configs can keep importing `viteburnerPlugin` from `viteburner`.
Added `getPluginConfig()` to read the resolved configuration.
Fixed `vite.config.*` being evaluated twice, which broke function-form Vite configs.
Fixed the bundled declarations to use type-only imports that resolve under Node16/NodeNext module resolution.
